grammar.summary: 本课学习表"自发"的 of one's own accord 与 table 复现结构。

points.title: of one's own accord 表自愿
points.explanation: He works of his own accord. = 自愿地。accord 的固定短语。

examples.en: Work of this kind is not labour but pleasure.
examples.cn: 这类活动不是劳作而是乐趣。

points.title: 表"分类"的 divide into 复现
points.explanation: divide A into B 把A分成B；rational/bureaucratic 的分类叙事。

examples.en: Hobbies are divided into two categories.
